command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
cd /tmp
printf '%s  fetch.sh\n' 5623564b19a120c86ee0ece09180ccad95399f56055b6c22edbef915739f623a > scripts.sha256
sha256sum -c scripts.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: fetch.sh does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
bash /tmp/fetch.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/fetch.log
exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}
